cc:Work.dc:description: A judge at 1.0 is a constant classifier: it casts the same vote on every parseable call. The implemented prevalence quadratic is then nonidentifying. Variation is necessary; passing this screen does not guarantee a physical recovery. No answer key enters this screen.
